why:

- Task 5: zero-dep static server + path-traversal guard

  port selection, idempotent start/stop, CLI with manifest precheck)
- Tasks 11-13: browser shell — pure logic (node:test headless) then DOM +
  3 themes (dark/light/sepia)
- Tasks 14-15: committed fixture wiki + e2e integration test

Stack: Node ESM + node:test (zero deps), hand-rolled mini markdown renderer
lifted from the approved mockup. Refinements vs spec wording documented in the
plan header (renderer choice, 2-file site/, DI for determinism, flat front-matter).

title: docs(spec): add /lore:serve local visualization to lore v1
why:
Add §5.5 designing /lore:serve — a local static server + single-file
browser shell so the wiki is viewable without Obsidian.

Design decisions (from brainstorming):
- Live server, backgrounded/detached, returns 127.0.0.1 URL, --stop kills
- Dumb static file server (runtime probe chain: python3 → python → bundled
  Node fallback), all rendering client-side
- Single-file vanilla-JS shell with embedded marked.js: sidebar facet nav,
  md render + [[wikilink]] in-shell routing, full-text search (title+summary),
  front-matter metadata bar (freshness/provenance), >=3 themes (dark/light/sepia)
- .lore/wiki/.manifest.json: machine-readable twin of INDEX.md, emitted as the
  final step of /lore:sync; dot-prefixed so Obsidian hides it
- Dual-renderer compatibility (serve shell + Obsidian coexist as read-only views)
- Promote serve into v1 (was v2); v2 narrows to relationship-graph visualization

Touches existing commands minimally: /lore:init copies shell, /lore:sync emits manifest.
Adds matching success criterion (#9), risks, and serve test layer.

Also add interactive mockup (embedded fixture data, opens via file://) at
docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-31-lore-serve-mockup.html — layout/color/theme
approved by user during brainstorming.
